fields.Title: Dunamiss Liquid Lipstick | Rose Play
fields.Body (HTML):

  • Finish: soft matte.
  • Enriched with jojoba oil, apricot kernel oil, passion fruit oil, vitamin E and a hyaluronic active.

fields.Body (HTML):
This Dunamiss nail polish duo includes Candy Cloud & Pearl Glow. Wear the shades separately or combine them in a manicure with a glossy finish.

  • Pack size: 2 nail polishes.
  • Included shades: Candy Cloud & Pearl Glow.
